page.overview:
Who is Joji Joestar?

Detective JoJo Jorge Joestar (Officially changed)

Defeating Dio Brando|namesake=George Joestar II George Joestar

Joji Joestar (城字・ジョースターJōji Jōsutā) mainly known as Jorge, is one of the main protagonists in JORGE JOESTAR, being the parallel version of George Joestar II. He is the temporary user of U-Boat after receiving it from Kars, and wields the omnipotent ability, Beyond.

As a private detective, Joji sets out on a bizarre quest to solve a murder in Morioh. During the investigation, Joji suddenly reaches outer space, and meets 36 versions of Kars, each created after Made In Heaven reset the world thirty-six times.
